name: Chaos na Karada W ~Futanari Ninshin Jikken
original_name: ChaosなカラダＷ～ふたなり妊娠実験
source:
"I'm superior to that woman... here is my proof!"
Alice screamed and clenched her fists tightly. 
She made this challenge to a rival scientist, Shizuka.
With the gauntlet thrown, Alice immediately began a new experiment... 
choosing her assistant as the test subject, Yoko Sasazuka. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE075245.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“我比那个女人更出色……这就是证据！”
爱丽丝尖叫着，双手紧紧攥成拳头。
她向竞争对手——科学家静——发起了挑战。
战书一下，爱丽丝立刻着手进行一项新实验……
并选中助手笹塚洋子作为实验对象。

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE075245.html]DLsite English[/url]]
